title: Doppler Estimator
text: Doppler estimation, 5 inputs, 2 outputs; {Maximum number of estimates}, {Enable cluster ID input}, {Output variance for parameter estimates} enables output variance port, {Number of pulses in Doppler processed waveform}, {Source of noise power}, {Noise power} and {Simulate using} sets the block simulation method Interpreted. Values come from the instance.

ports.summary: Doppler grid values along Doppler dimension real-valued P -by-1 column vector

ports.name: DetIdx

ports.name: NoisePower
ports.summary: Noise power at detection locations positive scalar | real-valued 1-by- Q row vector of positive values
